column1: # The ONE corpus for the learned-timeout clamp. TSV, tab-separated.
# tests/run_tests.sh drives the REAL shell (gf_criterion_timeout) over these
# rows; lean/LearnedTimeout.lean drives the Lean model over the same rows as
# #guard lines. The last column is the exact text of that #guard, and the suite
# greps for it -- so if the model and the implementation ever drift apart, or
# if either side is edited without the other, a test goes red.
